searchText: Hey, it seems that this fixed, we are experiencing similar on Ephemery testnet - do you have any wisdom to share? got a config dir for ephermery? We had the issue for `--contract-deployment-block on prysm/lodestar had to be set to 0` and change the eth1-follow-distance from 12 -> 2048 but the eth1 follow distance might not matter much I think it's a different problem we have in ephemery. ETH1 votes look fine and are consistent (but took longer than expected to be consistent), however the network is currently not finalizing due to some bad block issues. I guess new validator deposits are not processed during non-finality? ~~deposits _are_ processed during non-finality, just won’t be finalized~~ my bad, deposits are processed but `is_eligible_for_activation` checks finality before activating the validator
